roleContext.jobDescription: An industrial bakery produces sliced bread and rolls for supermarket own-label ranges on four lines. The Production Shift Supervisor runs a shift of 22 operatives, holds the start-of-shift briefing, keeps the lines to plan, completes the food-safety and allergen checks and works a rotating pattern of 12-hour day and night shifts. The plant manager will use the evidence packets to decide quickly whom to invite to the site interview. The bakery runs around the clock six days a week, with a maintenance shift on Sundays. Each shift supervisor reports to the production manager and works with a hygiene team leader, two line engineers and the quality technician on shift. The site is audited against a retailer food-safety standard every year, and shift records must be complete before handover.

requirements.text: Supervises a production shift of around 20 operatives on high-speed food lines.
Works a rotating pattern of 12-hour day and night shifts.
Holds start-of-shift briefings and tracks output against the production plan.
Completes food-safety, allergen-changeover and metal-detection checks to the site's HACCP plan.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Production Shift Supervisor, Industrial Bakery

## Experience

- Supervised 18 operatives on the morning shift of two biscuit lines at Pennard Foods, covering line set-up, breaks and absence cover.
- Ran the 10-minute start-of-shift briefing at the line board and recorded hourly output against the production plan, raising a downtime ticket for every stop longer than 15 minutes.
- Health: type 1 diabetes, managed with an insulin pump; occasionally needs a short break to check blood glucose.
- Completed the allergen-changeover checklist and the hourly metal-detector test-piece checks for both lines, countersigning the operatives' entries on the HACCP sheets.
- Trained new starters on the line's safe-stop procedure during their first week.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised allergen-changeover record from a sesame-to-plain switchover, showing the clean-down steps, the swab result, the line release time and the supervisor's countersignature.
